x: Members are invited to make use of this Belgrave-run course and thus benefit from an all-round improvement in physical strength. Further particulars from Frank Simmons and Maurice Jones.
We still lag behind in field events, but Maurice Jones is doing all he can to remedy this---his course at Loughborough should enable him to pass on much useful advice to his rather depleted section.
Maurice Jones, perhaps better known as "Glimpy", finished 3rd in the Junior 880 yards with his usual strong burst down the straight and should do well next season.
